ko.theme_desc: 달콤한 유혹에 빠진 인류, 붕어빵의 끈적한 촉수에 속절없이 사로잡히고 있다. 곧 붕어빵 공장에서 강제 노동을 하게 될지도.

scenarios.10y: 야, 붕어빵 군주님 맘에 들어야 살아남는다고, 붕어빵 먹방만 찍는 인플루언서래.
scenarios.20y: 어쩌다 붕어빵 포획 담당 돼서, 팔로워들 붕어빵 공장으로 끌고 가는 중.
scenarios.30y: 헐, 붕어빵 군주가 맘에 들었는지, 붕어빵 제국 황제가 되었다네!

en.theme_title: ⚠️ Warning: The Great Fish-Shaped Pastry Assimilation!
en.theme_desc: Humans are falling prey to the delicious allure of fish-shaped pastries, ensnared by their sticky embrace. Forced labor in the pastry factories looms.

scenarios.10y: Guess what? The influencer is now a 'taste tester' for the Fish-Shaped Bun overlords, only eating, reviewing, and liking fish-shaped buns.
scenarios.20y: Turns out, they're in charge of luring other humans into the fish-shaped bun factory with the perfect viral content.
scenarios.30y: Turns out the Fish-Shaped Bun Emperor was looking for a new heir, and our influencer got the throne!
